Their 198 input/evidence/review record bytes were read before acceptance and rechecked unchanged after acceptance. Required input sets, exact file hashes, source_commit values and dependency snapshots were compared with actual Git objects, not accepted merely because a migration script emitted them.

For every task, original accepted subject identity, evidence hashes, review hashes and wrapper references were compared with the original accepted Plan Git objects. Old records remain byte identical. New records are in a separate namespace and claim an analysis/review migration, not a new native experiment or review of translated bytes by the historical reviewers.

The two actual independent semantic reports and exact binding attestations cover disjoint sets of 45 and 21 subjects. Their reviewers differ from this Plan translator. Every subject and input-snapshot hash matches the exact current records; the acceptance index selects those same two attestations and all 66 subjects.

Task IDs, revisions, authors, declared dependencies, contract inputs, research/documentation references, outputs, write scopes, dependency pins, resource locks and owner roles retain their original mechanical meanings. All 48 Delivery nodes remain planned_candidate and not_authorized. The scoped translation revision-policy exception permits English packets while preserving task revisions, with fresh review and binding rather than new implementation permission.

The strict manifest pins all 140 translated Plan files and preserves six immutable originals. The graph review projection excludes only acceptance and hash/source metadata to avoid a digest cycle; the final manifest pins the full current graph bytes while formal snapshot and binding checks validate the excluded metadata. This report does not introduce a full graph hash as a cyclic prerequisite.

The guide describes a completed migration only after the actual original acceptance gate accepted the fresh records. Of the original ledger and verification trees, only the current completion index and the explicitly translated validator-contract.md differ: all other 353 files remain byte identical. Historical verification outputs remain distinct from new migration evidence.

The shared migration/checker code is byte identical to code previously read and independently reviewed. The resolved source-provenance, actor-independence, inline-code, comment-string and guide-path findings remain resolved. Existing CI commands are retained, with four strict translation/binding/completion commands added.
